title: Higher (gauged) Wess--Zumino--Witten terms based on Lie crossed modules
summary: We derive higher Wess--Zumino--Witten (WZW) and gauged WZW (gWZW) terms within strict higher Chern--Simons (CS) gauge theory. Starting from the Cartan homotopy formula, we obtain the $(2n+2)$-dimensional higher CS forms and transgression forms for strict Lie 2-groups presented by Lie crossed modules. Given two 2-connections related by a higher gauge transformation, higher transgression forms yield canonical higher WZW and gWZW terms.
